method: Synthetic, content-free cold-start evaluation. Ten distinct account-level writing archetypes are tested across all ten relationship contexts. Every draft is generated locally; no send endpoint and no external model is called.
limitations: Synthetic archetypes do not prove equal human-rated quality for every person or language.
The deterministic local fallback currently evaluates English, Roman Hindi and Roman Gujarati registers; broader language quality depends on an available multilingual model provider.
A brand-new account with no owner history cannot be cloned; it starts neutral and learns only from that account's evidence.
